channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, Media Arts, Film & Sound, US, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, Media Arts, Film & Sound, US, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound fellowship - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• BAVC MediaMaker Fellowship 2027
    https://bavc.org/programs/mediamaker/
    BAVC Media (Bay Area Video Coalition) · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · USD 10,000 distributed to each Fellow over the course of the fellowship, plus travel per diems. Non-cash support includes flights and accommodation for two San Francisco convenings, festival and conference access with travel covered, professional mentorship and strategy sessions, five hours of one-to-one mentorship through MediaMaker Connect, and ongoing workshops. Bay Area fellows also get access to BAVC's co-working space and facilities. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 8 new Media Arts, Film & Sound fellowships - week of 20 Apr 2026
item.description:
• Film Independent: Documentary Producing Lab 2026
    https://www.filmindependent.org/programs/applications/
    Film Independent · deadline Closed 04 May 2026 · Lab fellowship + access to bundled fellowships for selected fellows: Cayton-Goldrich (Jewish filmmakers, $10,000), MPAC Hollywood Bureau (American-Muslim, $10,000), Sony Music Vision ($10,000)
  • Film Independent: Fiction Producing Lab 2026
    https://www.filmindependent.org/programs/artist-development/fiction-producing-lab/
    Film Independent · deadline Closed 04 May 2026 · No tuition for the Lab itself. Accepted fellows must join Film Independent at $105/year. Bundled fellowship pathways: Alfred P. Sloan Producers Grant ($30,000 to one Lab participant whose project has a scientific, mathematical or technological theme or a leading scientist/engineer/mathematician character; documentaries and science fiction projects not eligible). Lab also opens access to bundled $10K Artist Development fellowships (Cayton-Goldrich, MPAC Hollywood Bureau, Sony Music Vision) for eligible fellows.
  • Backslash Fellowship 2026
    https://backslash.org/fellowship
    Backslash (Cornell Tech) · deadline Closed 08 May 2026 · $50,000 ($20K artist stipend + $20K materials + $10K collaborator) + studio space
  • Film Independent: Fast Track 2026
    https://www.filmindependent.org/programs/applications/
    Film Independent · deadline Closed 08 Jun 2026 · Selection unlocks Sloan Fast Track Grant + Climate Entertainment Development Grant ($25,000 for climate-focused fiction features) + Cayton-Goldrich / MPAC / Sony Music Vision $10K fellowships
  • Film Independent: Project Involve 2027
    https://www.filmindependent.org/programs/applications/
    Film Independent · deadline Closed 13 Jul 2026 · Multiple bundled fellowships for selected fellows: Amazon MGM Studios ($10,000), Climate Entertainment Commissioning Grant ($25,000 for a new climate-focused fiction feature script), LAIKA Animation Track (production grant + cash stipend, 5 fellows over 2 years), Panavision Fellowship ($60,000 camera package), Sony Pictures Entertainment ($10,000), University of Arizona TFTV ($10,000)
  • Film Independent: Screenwriting Lab 2027
    https://www.filmindependent.org/programs/applications/
    Film Independent · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · Lab fellowship + access to bundled $10K fellowships (Cayton-Goldrich, MPAC, Sony Music Vision) and Climate Entertainment Development Grant ($25K for climate-focused fiction features)
  • MacDowell Fellowship
    https://www.macdowell.org/apply/apply-for-fellowship
    MacDowell · deadline 10 Sep 2026 · No residency fee; need-based stipends and travel reimbursement available; ~300 fellowships/year
  • Film Independent: Episodic Directing Intensive 2027
    https://www.filmindependent.org/programs/applications/
    Film Independent · deadline 28 Sep 2026 · Lab fellowship + access to bundled $10K fellowships (Cayton-Goldrich, MPAC, Sony Music Vision) for selected fellows
